distribution.summary: 福建；广东；广西；贵州；湖南；四川；浙江；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) supports Guangdong, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Lin et al. (2024) adds Fujian, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hunan, Sichuan and Zhejiang. Smith et al. (2022) independently supports Guangdong, Guizhou, Hong Kong and Taiwan and provides locality evidence from Guizhou, Guiyang; it adds no new region to the current synthesis. Lau (2025) provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: The existing hosts Styrax; Camellia; Machilus thunbergii; Camphora officinarum are retained. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host in the integrated record and therefore adds no host taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus borealis Nobuchi, 1981.

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xylosandrus borealis Nobuchi, 1981, VSN_6508.
